name: Hold Person
description: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.
effect: A humanoid that fails a Wisdom save is paralyzed until it shakes it off.
notes: In combat: a humanoid that fails its Wisdom save is paralyzed: it can't act, and attacks against it have advantage. It saves again at the end of each of its turns. Concentration, 10 rounds.
